question: Should graph-aware `sessions_send` loop detection fail closed whenever a provenance chain revisits an agent?
rationale: The patch intentionally changes existing cyclic multi-agent routes from delivered agent runs into returned errors; maintainer intent is needed to decide whether that compatibility break is acceptable or needs an opt-in policy or escape hatch.

options.title: Accept fail-closed after proof
options.body: Require a clean rebase, redacted runtime proof, and the small error-message cleanup, then merge the provenance-chain guard as the intended cyclic-route policy.

options.title: Make cycle handling configurable
options.body: Ask for an explicit policy or config surface if legitimate revisit workflows must remain possible by default.

options.title: Pause the PR
options.body: Keep this PR in draft or close it if maintainers do not want core route policy to reject cyclic A2A chains yet.

recommendation.title: Accept fail-closed after proof
recommendation.body: Require a clean rebase, redacted runtime proof, and the small error-message cleanup, then merge the provenance-chain guard as the intended cyclic-route policy.
